We're here to show the defenders of Borleias what flying is all about.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>}}
The '''Taanab Yellow Aces''' was a volunteer [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. Formed and commanded by [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] fame during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the unit's name was a tribute to the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces]] of [[Tierfon/Legends|Tierfon]] and Janson's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. Janson had served in the Tierfon Yellow Aces with [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The squadron flew a mix of [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] and [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighters]] that featured distinct angular black striping. During the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]], the squadron also included [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]].

Following the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], the Yellow Aces joined with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] massed forces at [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]]. After serving as escorts during the crucial resupply of Borleias, the Yellow Aces worked within the new [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] to free [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] held by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] at [[Selvaris]].
